findings: The sidecar never exits on /run/shutdown by itself; the UI (src-ui/logics/common/useWindow.js asyncCloseApp) waits 2 s and Tauri ends it. The runner mirrors that.
The config default compute device is always the CPU entry; a CUDA build infers on CPU until the UI selects the GPU (an earlier runner revision passed without checking this).
spec/backend_cuda.spec (also on develop) collects hf_xet from the CPU .venv; harmless while both are 1.1.2, but CUDA-only setups fail to build. Split into a separate task.
limitations: single synthetic speaker; CER is a smoke signal
latency on a shared dev machine, not a performance claim
GUI (Tauri) integration checked separately by the user
